subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “It did not explain everything.”?
options: Students visiting the farm learned that new tools can change old work without making old knowledge useless.
However, the program included repair training because broken lanterns would become useless trash without local knowledge.
The old swing reminded everyone that a place can change without losing its story.
Students compared old tools with modern ones and felt grateful, but also thoughtful.
